message: expected a declaration or an `analog` block, found {found}
description: At module level, only declarations (ports, nets, parameters, variables, branches, functions, instances) and `analog` blocks are allowed. What is written here is none of them, often because a statement was placed outside the `analog` block.
actions: Move statements and contributions inside `analog begin ... end`.
Look at the source at the position shown, and at the end of the line before it: a syntax error is often noticed one token after the actual mistake.
